info.title: API-DocTest-Delete Fitness Memberships Cancel-v5-spec
info.description: The Cancel Fitness Memberships API allows users to effectively manage and cancel their fitness memberships. This endpoint is designed for existing members who wish to terminate their subscription, ensuring a streamlined process for membership cancellations. By leveraging this API, fitness centers can enhance customer service and improve operational efficiency. Typical consumers of this API may include gym management systems and mobile applications where users can easily manage their memberships.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel their memberships. Ensure that the membership is eligible for cancellation before making the request.

requestBody.description: Request body for cancelling a membership. This request should contain the necessary identifiers and any other required details to process the cancellation.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for canceling a membership operation via DELETE method.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelResponse_2.title: Cancel Membership Response

status.description: Indicates if the cancel operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the cancellation process.

state.description: The current state of the membership after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation.

audit.description: Information about the audit of the cancellation operation.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelResponse_2.description: Response schema for successfully canceling a membership.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was initiated automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Describes audit information for the cancellation operation.
